title: KitCatalogV1
description:
The minimum a release catalog must carry for the generic CLI to read it. Transcribed from the view the CLI already consumes: KitCatalogView and KitCatalogRelease in spfn packages/cli/src/kit/ports.ts, read by readCatalog and used by latestStableRelease.

Unlike every other contract in this set, this one is open rather than closed. It describes a generic view of a larger signed catalog snapshot, not the whole document — a real snapshot also carries channel, issuance and expiry fields, and each release carries a manifest digest. Setting additionalProperties false here would reject the very documents the contract exists to describe, so the schema states a floor and leaves the rest to the snapshot's own contract.

kitId.description: Which Kit this catalog is for. The CLI is generic, so this is a public ID rather than a fixed value.

sequence.description: Monotonic catalog sequence. The CLI tolerates its absence by defaulting to 0, but a producer has to emit it: without it a client cannot refuse an older snapshot replayed at it.

status.description: The two states the CLI distinguishes: latestStableRelease selects on stable, and a revoked release is never offered. Unit 05's signed snapshot draws a finer distinction (active, superseded, revoked); this generic view collapses it, and reconciling the two is recorded as an open question rather than decided here.
